reviews.text: Generative AI use?. I’ve only just downloaded the app, and overall it looks very thorough and user friendly! I’m just wondering if there’s a way to turn off the generative AI summaries as i’m not a fan and honestly find it kind of soulless and anti human🥲 thanks!
SO happy it's FREE!!. I love the layout for studying tarot. There are other apps I have tried, that do not let you progress in studying the cards without paying. Please keep this app free! 💜
SCAM. THEY STOLE MONEY FROM ME.
witches unite!. best thing to happen to tarot! learning more and more everyday using this app and my readings have been such a breeze now that i don’t have to look up every single card.
Amazing. Learning so much about myself
Error. I can't purchase the subscription it gives me an error :(

Best Tarot app, hands down. I’ve tried all the tarot apps and this one is the best. It’s the most straight forward and handy resource for my readings when I need to review the meanings. What it offers without the paid subscription is great. Definitely recommend this one if you want a clean and easy tarot app.

Pay to use. Just like the reviews state it’s a great informative app, it does use generative AI though. Unfortunately once you use up your three free energy it does not restock after 24hours. Instead it’s permanently gone and you need to pay for the subscription to get detailed information. If you want to understand what the reading is saying be prepared to open your wallet. Seems like a cash grab by doing that

HUGE advisor for you!. I have looked online and on apps but many ether charge for in detail or some just say tooooo much that have not much explanation. This app has every card. Every singles details from yes/no to the chakra they are connected with! I’ve learned a lot from here and it helped me a lot to be in more detail with my readings :) download !!!!
Great for learning!. This app has been very helpful in my regular tarot practice. Very easy to use, deeply informative and engaging!
So far I love it!. i’ve only had this for a few days and I must say it is really impressive
Doesn’t work on my phone.. The app won’t even open on my iPhone 8 Plus. Can’t use it.
Best app EVER. I love learning from this app as well as getting my everyday readings. I love the quizzes too!!
Lots of good energy here. Just getting started on this app but so far the energy it gives me is great and a wonderful way to start my day 🙌✨
Insightful. Fun and educational app that gives me interesting insight into my life!

Scary accurate and super easy to use!. I’ve tried pretty much every tarot app out there and this is the only one that actually feels like getting a real reading. It’s super quick, really easy to use, and scary accurate. The free-form readings are my favorite because you can ask follow-up questions and it feels like the reading actually continues. Only thing I wish it had was a way to study the cards but honestly that’s minor compared to how good the readings are.

So easy to learn. This app has made it super clear and easy to learn. I’d like to ask for an improvement, if I may, I’d love for the app to be able to read the descriptions to me. So, à voiceover, as this is how I learn best and saves my eyes ❤️thank you
